correctness.rationale: Each constructive branch follows directly from the defining prime-power divisibility: n=2 for odd parameters; n=2^{v_2(mu)+1} for even non-powers of two; and n=p for any prime p dividing mu+1 when mu is a power of two with composite successor. If 2^v+1 is prime, the standard factorization of x^t+1 for odd t forces v to be a power of two. The explicit witnesses 145 for mu=256 and 627 for mu=65536 satisfy all required prime divisibilities exactly.

value.rationale: The result compresses the entire positive half of an explicit existence conjecture to an exceptionally sparse classical obstruction: any remaining positive counterexample would require a new Fermat prime beyond the five currently known Fermat primes.
